children: Apollo suspended its Direct Stock Purchase and Dividend Reinvestment Plan effective Sept. 29, 2026, and will issue future dividends in cash.
Plan suspension begins Sept. 29, 2026; plan may be terminated later as determined by Apollo.
Future Apollo dividend payments will be issued in cash rather than reinvested under the Plan.
Last direct stock purchases under the Plan occur Sept. 28, 2026; last recurring ACH debit is Sept. 25, 2026.
Funds received on/after Sept. 28, 2026 for stock purchases will be returned to participants by Equiniti Trust Company, LLC.
